name: elice Inc.
summary: elice Inc. provides AI-focused cloud infrastructure and solutions, including modular data centers and cloud services for AI education, research, and model development. The company offers Elice LXP, and education practice platform; Elice Test, an one-stop test solution for all types of assessments; educational content library; and end-to-end support for related activities, as well as offers cloud services. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
